newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Gibson's rejects Pivot takeover bid.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Gibson's rejects Pivot takeover bid.

text.p: Flour and stockfeed miller Gibson's Ltd said on Monday its independent directors have recommended that shareholders reject a takeover bid from Pivot Nutrition Pty Ltd, the group's major shareholder.

Gibson's independent directors said the Pivot offer should be rejected as an independent expert's report had concluded the offer is not fair and not reasonable. The report valued Gibson's shares in the range of A$5.30 to A$6.15. Pivot Nutrition, which is a unit of unlisted Pivot Group, is offering Gibson's shareholders A$4.90 cash per share, ex-dividend.
Gibson's independent directors said they would not be accepting the offer on behalf of their own shareholding.
Gibson's shares last traded at A$5.00 on Friday, one cent lower than the previous day's close.
